title: Rabbi Mena’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Dikdukei Soferim, Berakhot 55b, note 8, cites a reading from Yuchasin: Rabbi Tanchum reports Rabbi Biram in the name of an elder—who was he? Rabbi Mena'ah. Rabbi Mena'ah reports an elder—who was he? Rabbi Nehorai.

notes.text: מיוחסין means “from Yuchasin,” not “regarding lineage.” The two “who was he?” clauses identify the elders within the reported reading.

The consulted printed Dikdukei Soferim, Berakhot, p. 304, note ח (8), explicitly quotes this chain from Yuchasin, including Tanchum, Biram, Mena’ah and Nehorai. Hyman excerpts the end of a longer chain. The note also records other readings, while the consulted current text of Berakhot 55b names Bena’a in the dream-interpreters passage. These variant names are not treated here as an established identification of Mena’ah with Bena’a or Nehorai. Yuchasin itself has not been independently collated.
